stage: Question 3b, approved by the user on 2026-10-15: player-player relations within the current match, both with the anchor actor and with every window actor, built on H_match (the user's choice of base, 14:24). Same fixed schedule, seeds and learning rate as stages 2 and 3a; H_match of stage 3a is the reference and is not rerun. Only the execution differs: three runs per GPU, so all nine run at once.

questions.Q3b: Do player-player relations in the current match add information beyond the candidate's own whole-match history? Contrasts P_anchor - H_match (relation with the anchor actor), P_window - H_match (relations with every window actor), P_window - P_anchor, with P_window - P_window_shuffled as the binding control.

candidates.rule: on-pitch at the anchor using only information available then
candidates.starter: candidate until substituted off or sent off
candidates.incoming: candidate once clock >= (minute + 1) * 60 s or once observed acting at or before the anchor
candidates.sent_off: removed after a foul with tag 1701 or 1703 strictly before the anchor
candidates.clock: seconds in period plus 2700 s for the second half
candidates.unreachable: targets outside the candidate set count as misses in top-k and are excluded from the loss and NLL; their number is reported

context.event_identity: conditions with context_identity true add to each window unit token the static candidate state of each of its roster participants (the same Projection as the candidate side, so context and candidates share one player embedding); merged duels add both participants
inputs: team relation of participants to the reference team
excluded: whether a unit was performed by the anchor actor

scorers.mlp_plus_dot: MLP([context, candidate state]) + (W context) . (candidate state) / sqrt(64); W is a 64 x 64 linear map without bias, initialised at zero, so at initialisation the scores equal those of the MLP scorer

static: same team as the reference team
history_event: unit team relation to the reference team

summary_added: log1p acting units in the match up to the anchor
log1p units since the latest of them / 8
match_scope.history: the latest 32 acting units of the whole match up to the anchor instead of the window; units before the anchor / 80 saturates at 79/80, and two features are added: outside the window, log1p units before the anchor / 8
match_scope.shuffled_control: H_match_shuffled swaps whole histories among same-team on-pitch candidates per sample, as M2_shuffled; summaries stay real

pairs.transition: consecutive units of a match whose participants are different players: one transition from each participant of the earlier unit to each participant of the later one; a transition counts once the anchor has reached its later unit
pair_values: log1p transitions from the other player to the candidate
log1p transitions from the candidate to the other player
log1p units since the latest transition to the candidate / 8
no transition to the candidate yet
pairs.anchor: pair values with the anchor unit's participants (counts summed, latest transition over them)
pairs.window: the anchor pair values, plus one token per other player who acted in the window: their pair values with the candidate, log1p their window appearances, units since their latest window appearance / 80, whether they are the anchor actor, whether they share the candidate's team; tokens are mean-pooled
pairs.shuffled_control: P_window_shuffled swaps all pair inputs among same-team on-pitch candidates per sample with the permutation used by the history controls
pairs.initialisation: the pair branches are created after every other module and their output layers start at zero, so at initialisation the scores equal those of H_match

schedule.rule: constant learning rate for epochs 1-96, x0.3 for epochs 97-108 and x0.09 for epochs 109-120; no plateau stopping

learning_rate.rule: the stage-1 lock (search on M0_static and M3_attention); no new search

decision.positive: top-1 on single-actor targets +1.0 pp or player NLL -0.03, all 3 seeds in the same direction and the match-bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero
decision.primary_view: single-actor targets; unreachable targets count as misses for top-k

contrasts: Q3b: pair relations with the anchor actor over own whole-match history
Q3b: pair relations with every window actor over own whole-match history
Relations with the other window actors over those with the anchor actor alone
Q3b control: pair relations bound to the right candidate
